setting.description: Determines if the language toggles are visible for a given journal, allowed values 'none','header','footer','both'. Other values disable both toggles. If the setting is missing 'both' is assmumed
setting.name: tuw_language_toggle_visibility

setting.description: Determines if the Janeway logo is shown in the footer
setting.name: tuw_show_janeway_logo

setting.description: Determines if self registration is possible 'no','direct','orcid','both'. If the setting is missing 'no' is assumed. Work in progress: for now only hides link, doesn't deactivate self-registration for real
setting.name: tuw_self_registration
